claude_proposed_widenings.name: suppress_concentration_break
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: No atom expresses 'taking damage cannot break concentration on [specific spell]'. The mechanic is full immunity to the damage-induced concentration check, scoped to a named spell. This is distinct from advantage (modify_roll_advantage) and from any existing saveSourceFilter variant. The v4 taxonomy has no concept for this.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Taking damage can't break your Concentration on Hunter's Mark.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: saveSourceFilter { kind: 'damage_induced_concentration_check'; spellId: string }
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Even if a suppress/immunity mode were added to modify_roll_advantage, scoping it to 'concentration checks specifically caused by taking damage for a named spell' requires a new saveSourceFilter variant. The existing variant only covers 'spell_or_other_magical_effect' and cannot express the concentration-break-on-damage trigger scoped to a specific spell.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Taking damage can't break your Concentration on Hunter's Mark.
